# Installed selector fixtures

These test-only CFB1, TPS1 and EVR1 records are generated by the signed corpus
builder in `tests/support/mod.rs`. They contain deterministic test keys, not
production credentials. The valid, incompatible-mode, invalid-signature,
invalid-profile and selected-cap cases exercise installed selector authority.

The `fixture_export::export_installed_selector_fixtures` integration test
regenerates every record and requires byte-for-byte equality. It runs through
the normal workspace test gate. Set `SELECTOR_FIXTURE_EXPORT` on a hosted
runner to retain the regenerated copies in a chosen output directory.

Do not hand-edit these binary records. Change the builder and regenerate them
together with the parity expectations when the test contract changes.
